collect_parameters: collect model and quantile parameters from a hyperprior autoencoder for separate optimizer groups
ste_quantize_latent: quantize a latent tensor using the straight-through estimator with optional mean shifting
set_compress_cpu_layers: set which neural network layers should be moved to CPU during compression
compress_image: compress an input image tensor into a HyperpriorCompressedOutput using the hyperprior autoencoder
decompress_data: decompress a HyperpriorCompressedOutput back into a reconstructed image tensor
